prompt.text: I am trying to get folks interested in joining my companies business opportunity.. Folks get compensated for sharing our products and services on social media and other areas. I have a free quiz tool that I can share with folks to see if this opportunity would be a GOOD FIT for them… What type of posts can I put up on social media to entice folks to DM me to get the link to the free quiz tool to see if my opportunity would be a good fit for them based on their lifestyle, goals and time availability?
